method: Official public pages opened with web.run; references recorded as URLs, not archival release vintages

checks.result: Official CPI time-series page links COICOP2018 data, the CEN0101E CSV, schema and DataStat documentation. Archived pre-2018 and 2018-onward classifications are separately listed.

Official basket archive lists annual baskets through 2026. The 2026 basket uses constant 2024 weights; 2024/2025 use 2022, 2022/2023 use 2020 and earlier even-year cycles follow the same basis pattern.

Live schema confirms index-type and household codes but now has split geography/time fields, including UZ02P.KRAJ and CASMKMQRM12.CAS_M, unlike the archived raw schema. It must not be applied silently to the frozen raw.
CZSO describes CPI weights as expenditure shares of representative goods/services, distinguishes index reference/base periods and links the current CPI user manual.

limits: The web tool cannot render the CSV/XLSX/DOCX downloads, but confirms the official link destinations. Direct public urllib downloads were blocked by network sandbox, retained in verification_log.json. All actual numerical source bytes come from the previously audited full official raw CSV and basket workbooks, whose checksums are preserved.
